label: calce

ocv.method: SP1 independent 25C 0.05C discharge; trapezoidal current integration, Qnom=2Ah, z0=1; 0.002 SOC median bins; monotonic cumulative maximum
ocv.limitation: low-current OCV approximation, different cell; fixed 25C curve reused zero-shot at all temperatures
ocv.duplicate_policy: Preserve rows as unified calibration; zero-dt intervals integrate zero Ah.
ocv.interpolation: PCHIP V(SOC); hold at measured support

protocol.V1_OCV: SP1 independent 25C low-current discharge step 3, Q=2Ah, trapezoidal integration; same 0.002 SOC median bins and cumulative-maximum denoising as unified, PCHIP voltage(SOC), boundary hold at measured support.
protocol.z0_V1_V5: Reuse each profile's documented causal initial SOC from read-only unified summary, with raw-file hash verification; no new target fitting.
protocol.z0_V6_V7: Keep requested [0.9,1.0] even though SP2 80SOC source starts near 0.82. Transfer source-fitted z0 unchanged to all targets. User confirmed this incompatibility must be disclosed.
protocol.soc: Step 7 only, canonical net Ah = Discharge_Capacity minus Charge_Capacity offset at first sample, preserving regeneration; no discharge-only counter or end normalization.

OCVT_Q_policy: OCV branches normalized by measured local low-current capacity as existing loader; dynamic Qreference remains Q25 +/-10%; only V6-OCVT substitutes local curve
